value.rationale: The parameter is a canonical small instance of arbitrary Cayley permutation coding, and the contribution is a full equality classification rather than a routine recomputation of a bound. Equality forces a rigid C5-subgroup/normalizer-coset geometry, yielding an exact census, pair-distance rigidity, and a single symmetry orbit that can serve as a finite benchmark for construction and bound methods.
